gaps.normative_requirement: Test samples must be representative of the apparatus supplied to the user or be the actual apparatus ready for shipment.
gaps.finding_reason: The particulars record steam discharge and a detachable liquid container for the declared speaker, without explaining their relationship to the photographed sample; attribution of the assessment to model 2 is therefore uncertain.
gaps.required_action: Verify the tested sample’s identity and replace the inconsistent particulars with a traceable product description.

gaps.normative_requirement: Normal operating tests use the specified supply-voltage variation and, where applicable, a test supply with suitable current capacity and characteristics.
gaps.finding_reason: The 5 V rated product was tested for heating at 4.5 V and 5 V; the record does not establish whether 5.5 V was less unfavourable or identify the supply characteristics needed to assess the USB supply arrangement.
gaps.required_action: Establish the applicable supply arrangement and test or justify the most unfavourable voltage and supply characteristics.

gaps.normative_requirement: Temperature measurements must use the specified positioning, and the apparatus must also meet Table 3 when tested on an open bench.
gaps.finding_reason: The report refers to the user manual but does not identify the heating-test positioning or record a separate open-bench assessment.
gaps.required_action: Document the test positioning and provide the required open-bench results.

gaps.normative_requirement: An audio amplifier is operated at one-eighth of non-clipped output power using the specified signal or an allowed alternative.
gaps.finding_reason: The table records 0.10 W as one-eighth of maximum output, but does not record the measured non-clipped output power or identify the test signal and its characteristics.
gaps.required_action: Provide the non-clipped output-power determination and identify the signal used for the heating test.

gaps.normative_requirement: Apparatus supplied by d.c. only must be marked with the specified d.c. supply symbol.
gaps.finding_reason: The marking-plate copy shows "DC 5V 1A" but does not show the specified d.c. symbol, although the report assigns a pass to the voltage and symbol item.
gaps.required_action: Provide and verify a corrected marking plate bearing the applicable supply symbol.

gaps.normative_requirement: Temperature rises must not exceed the applicable Table 3 values, considering the part and relevant conditions.
gaps.finding_reason: The table assigns a 55 K limit to the battery and outside enclosure, but does not identify the battery chemistry, enclosure material or basis for those limits; the measured rises are 5.0 K and 5.3 K respectively.
gaps.required_action: Identify the materials and battery chemistry and substantiate the applicable temperature-rise limits.

gaps.normative_requirement: The supplied edition contains specific construction, component and mounting requirements under its own clause numbering.
gaps.finding_reason: The report uses a different clause structure: for example, it labels 8.12 void although the supplied standard contains a fastening requirement there, and battery and mounting provisions are also shifted.
gaps.required_action: Issue a report correctly mapped to IEC 60065:2014 and reassess the applicable requirements.

gaps.normative_requirement: The enclosure must be sufficiently resistant to external forces and compliance is checked by the specified tests.
gaps.finding_reason: The external-force assessment is marked N without a reason or test record.
gaps.required_action: Perform and record the applicable enclosure force tests or provide a standard-based justification.

gaps.normative_requirement: Safety must not be impaired by humidity encountered in intended use, with humidity treatment followed by the applicable insulation tests.
gaps.finding_reason: Humidity treatment is marked N without explanation, and the insulation resistance and electric strength tables contain no results.
gaps.required_action: Provide the humidity-treatment assessment and subsequent applicable insulation-test results, or justify each exclusion.

gaps.normative_requirement: Portable apparatus is subject to the specified vibration test and, at 7 kg or less, the drop test.
gaps.finding_reason: The report identifies the apparatus as portable and below 7 kg, yet marks both vibration and drop tests N without justification.
gaps.required_action: Conduct and document the vibration and drop tests on the representative apparatus.

gaps.normative_requirement: Moulded or formed thermoplastic enclosures must undergo the specified stress-relief assessment.
gaps.finding_reason: The report identifies screws fixing a plastic enclosure but marks the thermoplastic enclosure stress-relief test N without identifying the material or construction.
gaps.required_action: Identify the enclosure material and perform the stress-relief test if it is moulded or formed thermoplastic.

gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant fault conditions are applied individually, with consequential faults, to check that hazardous overheating does not occur.
gaps.finding_reason: Several fault tests are recorded, but the report provides no circuit-based fault selection or justification for omitting component short-circuit and disconnection conditions.
gaps.required_action: Provide the circuit analysis and results or justified exclusions for the relevant fault conditions.

gaps.normative_requirement: Batteries must be mounted to prevent hazardous gas accumulation and insulation damage, and applicable charging or lithium currents must remain within manufacturer limits.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records battery overcharge testing but lists a 1.5 V R03 battery and marks battery mounting and charging-current assessments N; the battery chemistry, rechargeability and current limits are not established.
gaps.required_action: Identify the installed battery and charging arrangement and provide the applicable mounting and current-limit assessments.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable special batteries must withstand the specified mould stress-relief and drop tests without releasing electrolyte.
gaps.finding_reason: Battery mould stress relief and drop tests are marked P, but no sample details, conditioning, drop results or evidence establishing applicability are recorded.
gaps.required_action: Provide the test records and applicability basis for both battery assessments.

final_summary.evaluation_conclusion: The supplied report does not provide a reliable basis for demonstrating compliance of speaker model 2 with IEC 60065:2014. Sample identity, supply and battery configuration, mechanical testing, humidity treatment, fault selection and temperature-limit justification require resolution and reassessment.
final_summary.recommended_action: Obtain a correctly attributed, edition-aligned replacement report with the missing assessments and supporting test records before certification proceeds.
